blockade.description: Fills a 5-ft. square with an enormous block of wood, providing cover and blocking movement. Created as a swift action.

armor_lock.description: Target's armor becomes restrictive and locks up. Target's speed is reduced to 10 ft. and take extra armor check penalties.

spell_theft.description: Make a dispel check. For each active spell successfully dispelled from the target, you gain the benefits of that spell for the remainder of its duration.
